name: OmniSportsSwitch
description: Measures stream audio per tab, sends it to the local OmniSportsSwitch daemon, and swaps tabs between windows on its command.

track-tab.description: Track (or re-track) the current tab - use it after a page reloads or the view changes

toggle-freeze.description: Freeze or unfreeze Main (stops automatic swaps and tile changes)

toggle-freeze-window2.description: Freeze or unfreeze Window 2 (no swap moves its stream)
